scope: offline reference package; not a production gate and not field calibration

W.name: multi-location typical-weather QC and illustrative model sensitivity
W.truth: no measured PV output; weather-source/regression only
W.calendar: explicit synthetic non-leap 2001 local standard time, source month/day/hour, no DST; hourly irradiance evaluated at interval midpoint

parameters.wind_to_reference_height: not converted; illustrative Faiman scenario only, not calibration

outputs: scenario AC energy for Faiman and SAPM open_rack_glass_polymer
paired thermal model sensitivity, not accuracy ranking

L.name: repackaged NREL/Sandia/CFV laboratory matrix cross-technology holdout
L.truth: upstream repackaged laboratory p_mp measurements; not original XLSX verified and not field timeseries
L.split: hold out ALL 600 and 800 W/m2 matrix points at all temperatures; fit remaining irradiance levels; require a 25 C, 1000 W/m2 training point and positive finite data
models: PVWatts-form two-parameter least-squares fitted on training only
ADR five-parameter pvlib fit on identical training only
L.normalization: training STC measured Pmp, never held-out peak or full-dataset quantile
metrics: holdout RMSE divided by training STC power

F.name: multi-climate measured field validation
F.split: group by physical module and campaign; cross-climate leave-one-site-out; seasonal chronological blocks within site; purge interval at least longest model history; freeze final test before fitting
metrics: paired common-mask MAE/RMSE/bias in physical units
coverage/missingness by site season and QC reason
energy bias only for intervals with defensible integration and coverage
paired day/block bootstrap confidence intervals with block-length sensitivity
F.exclusions: no zero fill, no interpolation across missing I-V observations to claim annual truth, no time-series random split, no shared physical module across train/test claimed independent

thresholdPolicy: integrity and structural assertions may PASS; empirical model accuracy is reported, not assigned invented universal acceptance limits
userImpact: missing research data limits only its benchmark or model claim; baseline powerplant/ongrid/offgrid calculations remain independent
